about_short_description.short_description: CX2 Focused on achieving spectrum control for electromagnetic warfare for the U.S. and its allies.

product.name: Wraith™
product.description: An airborne electronic-warfare platform that detects, geolocates, and maps hostile RF emitters, including jammers, drone pilots, and ground-control stations, in GPS-denied environments.

product.name: Vadris™
product.description: An RF-seeking payload for FPV drones that detects and characterizes signals from drone control links, identifies their direction, and guides operators toward ground-control stations or other emitters.
